title: Healed by His Stripes: Divine Healing in the Blood of Jesus
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner teaches on the life-changing power of Christ's blood and the victory it brings to our lives. As he shares from Scripture, Pastor Chris guides listeners to stand on the promises of protection, healing, and redemption, reminding them that they are loved, healed, and saved because of Jesus' sacrifice on the cross. Listen to be encouraged, strengthened, and empowered to live a life of victory and triumph in Christ.
